The identical clause built on a full noun-phrase subject stays at the floor ('The man was ready for the test' 0.09, 'The men were ready for the test' 0.13, 'The woman has a copy of the long letter' 0.17, 'The women have a copy of the long letter' 0.13), and pronouns in a non-subject role are also quiet ('saw him' / 'saw me' / 'saw her' / 'saw you' 0.00, 'saw them' 0.22); a weaker secondary component fires on scattered common content words ('home' after 'went', 'public', 'local').
